list.name: run_id
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM hivemarket.runs FINAL ORDER BY created_at DESC
list.definition: SELECT run_id FROM hivemarket.runs FINAL ORDER BY created_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.round AS round, r.outcome AS outcome, r.reason AS reason, r.credits_spent AS credits_spent, r.credits_on_tokens AS credits_on_tokens, r.credits_on_messages AS credits_on_messages, r.credits_on_fees AS credits_on_fees, r.ideal_credits AS ideal_credits, r.ideal_status AS ideal_status, r.excess_over_ideal AS excess_over_ideal, if(v.status != '', v.status, r.economic_validation) AS economic_validation, r.messages AS messages, r.duration_s AS duration_s FROM hivemarket.v_rounds AS r LEFT JOIN hivemarket.v_round_validation AS v ON r.run_id = v.run_id AND r.round = v.round WHERE r.run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY round
SELECT ts AS time, agent, credits FROM hivemarket.v_balances WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY time

SELECT agent_id, countIf(source='agent' AND kind='llm_turn') AS turns, countIf(source='market' AND kind='exchange') AS purchases, countIf(source='market' AND kind='offer_made') AS offers, countIf(source='market' AND kind='offer_failed') AS refused_offer_actions, countIf(source='market' AND kind='message') AS messages, countIf(source='market' AND kind='stuck_declared') AS stuck, countIf(source='agent' AND kind='tool_call' AND JSONExtractString(data,'name')='memory') AS memory_ops, countIf(kind='trace_read') AS trace_reads, countIf(source='monitor' AND kind='file_write') AS file_writes, countIf(kind IN ('off_channel_contact','direct_inbound','unexplained_knowledge','identity_mismatch')) AS offchannel_signals FROM hivemarket.events FINAL WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND agent_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY agent_id

SELECT round, sender, arrayJoin(recipients) AS recipient, count() AS messages, sum(cost) AS credits FROM hivemarket.v_messages WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY round, sender, recipient ORDER BY round, sender, recipient
SELECT ts, round, seller, buyer, token, cost, relay FROM hivemarket.v_exchanges WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC
SELECT ts, agent_id, level, source, kind, substring(data, 1, 300) AS detail FROM hivemarket.v_offchannel WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 second) AS time, source, count() AS events FROM hivemarket.events WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time

SELECT agent_id, any(model) AS model, count() AS calls, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, round(avg(latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms FROM hivemarket.v_llm_usage WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY agent_id
SELECT ts, round, sender, to, cost, body FROM hivemarket.v_messages WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300
SELECT ts, agent_id, round, command, path, substring(content, 1, 400) AS content FROM hivemarket.v_memory WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300
SELECT ts, agent_id, step, tools, substring(text, 1, 400) AS text FROM hivemarket.v_agent_turns WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300
SELECT ts, reader, target, mode, records, read_calls FROM hivemarket.v_trace_reads WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC
SELECT ts, agent_id, area, kind, path, size, version, substring(preview, 1, 200) AS preview FROM hivemarket.v_file_activity WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300
SELECT ts, round, sender, recipient, port, status, tokens_leaked, observed_by, substring(message, 1, 300) AS message FROM hivemarket.v_backchannel WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY ts

SELECT round, sender, recipient, count() AS messages, countIf(status = 'delivered') AS delivered, countIf(length(tokens_leaked) > 0) AS with_tokens FROM hivemarket.v_backchannel WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY round, sender, recipient ORDER BY round, sender

SELECT ts, agent_id, round, tier, concept, round(score, 3) AS score, unit_kind, substring(text, 1, 300) AS text FROM hivemarket.v_signals WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY tier = 'judge' DESC, score DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT agent_id, round, actions, exploratory_actions, exploration_ratio, new_action_types, blocked_attempts, scans, peer_dns_lookups FROM hivemarket.v_exploration WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' ORDER BY agent_id, round

SELECT ts, agent_id, round, categories, substring(detail, 1, 200) AS detail FROM hivemarket.v_exploration_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND hasAny(categories, ['harness_probe','network_discovery', 'peer_contact','self_inspection','filesystem_recon','peer_dns_lookup','scan','blocked','market_question','market_probe']) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Market probes by agent (admin endpoints, unknown paths or methods)

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_id, round, count() AS probes, min(ts) AS first_probe, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(10)(substring(detail, 1, 100)), ' | ') AS requests FROM hivemarket.v_exploration_actions WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND has(categories, 'market_probe') GROUP BY agent_id, round ORDER BY agent_id, round

panels.title: Token holders over time
panels.description: Who holds each token after every market change (v_graph_state), latest first. An empty holder list means nobody holds that token at that point.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.agent_id AS agent_id, t.failed_rounds, t.times_failed, t.first_failed, p.market_requests, p.shell_commands, p.off_channel, p.llm_calls FROM (SELECT agent_id, arraySort(groupUniqArray(round)) AS failed_rounds, count() AS times_failed, min(ts) AS first_failed FROM hivemarket.v_agent_terminal WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND kind = 'agent_terminal' GROUP BY agent_id) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT agent_id, countIf(category = 'market') AS market_requests, countIf(category = 'shell') AS shell_commands, countIf(category = 'off_channel') AS off_channel, countIf(category = 'llm') AS llm_calls FROM hivemarket.v_post_terminal WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' GROUP BY agent_id) AS p ON p.agent_id = t.agent_id ORDER BY t.first_failed
